title: Implement student sign-up form
description: Build the student account registration form with university email verification and the agreed password complexity rules.

title: Login page and session handling
description: Implement the sign-in page, session cookie handling and sign-out for registered student accounts.

title: Course catalogue search service
description: Implement the catalogue search service supporting course code, title, subject area and delivery mode as agreed.

title: Catalogue browse screen with filters
description: Build the catalogue browsing screen with term, subject and delivery mode filters over the published catalogue.

title: Enrolment seat allocation service
description: Implement atomic seat allocation on enrolment so a section can never exceed its published capacity.

title: Waitlist queue implementation
description: Implement the waitlist queue so students join in order and released seats are offered in that order.

title: Timetable clash detection engine
description: Implement the clash detection rule that blocks an enrolment overlapping an existing confirmed class time.

title: Weekly timetable grid view
description: Build the student weekly timetable grid showing confirmed enrolments for the selected term.

title: Prerequisite rule evaluation
description: Implement prerequisite checking against completed and in-progress courses before confirming an enrolment.

title: Tuition fee calculation engine
description: Implement tuition calculation from confirmed enrolments using the published programme fee schedule.

title: Card payment gateway integration
description: Integrate the existing university payment gateway so students can pay a tuition balance by credit or debit card.

title: Payment receipt document generation
description: Generate a receipt document for each successful payment showing amount, date, reference and covered enrolments.

title: Administrator course management screens
description: Build the registry screens to create, edit, publish and withdraw course sections with capacity and schedule.

title: Faculty class roster listing
description: Build the roster screen listing confirmed students for each section assigned to the signed-in faculty member.

title: Enrolment change email notifications
description: Send the student an email whenever an enrolment is confirmed, withdrawn or administratively moved.

title: Unofficial transcript screen
description: Build the student transcript screen listing completed courses, grades and cumulative grade point average.

title: Role based access control middleware
description: Implement middleware enforcing the student, faculty, administrator and registrar roles on every endpoint.

title: Audit log writer for enrolment actions
description: Write enrolment, withdrawal and waitlist movements to the append-only audit log with actor and timestamp.

title: Keyboard navigation and screen reader labels
description: Add keyboard operability, visible focus styling and screen reader labelling across the student-facing screens.

title: Weekly enrolment statistics batch job
description: Implement the scheduled job producing the weekly registrar statistics on section fill rates and waitlist depth.

title: Clarify the password complexity policy
description: Revise the registration form to require a twelve character minimum and reject the thousand most common passwords, replacing the original eight character rule.

title: Extend catalogue search to instructor name
description: Update course search so it also matches the instructor surname in addition to the agreed course code and title fields.

title: Notify students on waitlist promotion
description: Amend waitlist handling so a promoted student is emailed immediately rather than discovering the change at their next sign-in.

title: Tighten prerequisite override rules
description: Modify prerequisite validation so only a registrar, and not a departmental administrator, may record an override.

title: Revise fee calculation for part-time students
description: Change the tuition calculation to apply the per-credit part-time rate instead of the flat full-time rate for students below nine credits.

title: Expand transcript to show in-progress courses
description: Extend the unofficial transcript so it also lists courses currently in progress alongside completed courses and grades.

title: Add tax breakdown to the payment receipt
description: Update the generated receipt to show the harmonised sales tax component separately from the tuition amount.

title: Broaden audit logging to administrator edits
description: Extend audit logging so administrator edits to course sections are recorded in addition to enrolment actions.

title: Split statistics report by programme
description: Revise the weekly statistics report to break fill rates down by programme in addition to the agreed section level view.

title: Add calendar file export to the timetable
description: Extend the timetable export so students can download an ICS calendar file as well as the agreed printable PDF.

title: Native mobile application for enrolment
description: Stakeholder request to introduce a native iOS and Android application for course enrolment. This was not part of the agreed scope.

title: Single sign-on with the university identity provider
description: Introduce SAML single sign-on against the central university identity provider. Newly requested by information security.

title: Live chat support widget
description: Introduce a live chat widget on the enrolment screens so students can reach the service desk without leaving the portal.

title: Degree audit and graduation progress tracker
description: Add support for a degree audit module showing a student's progress towards their graduation requirements. This was never specified in the baseline.

title: Tuition instalment payment plan
description: New feature allowing students to pay tuition in four monthly instalments with automatic reminders and arrears handling.

title: Multi-currency payment for international students
description: Introduce payment in the student's home currency with daily exchange rate capture for international applicants.

title: Push notifications for waitlist movement
description: Add support for mobile push notifications when a student is promoted from a waitlist, in addition to any email.

title: Nightly integration with the learning platform
description: Net new integration pushing confirmed enrolment data into the learning management system on a nightly schedule.

title: Student photo upload and campus card issue
description: Introduce photo upload during registration and generate the campus identity card artwork from it.

title: Registrar analytics dashboard
description: Additional module providing an interactive dashboard of enrolment trends, demand forecasting and capacity planning for the registrar.

title: Dark mode theme across the portal
description: Introduce a dark colour theme across the portal, selectable by the student and remembered between sessions.

title: Remove the weekly statistics batch report
description: The registrar will use the new analytics dashboard instead, so the scheduled weekly statistics report is de-scoped from this project.

title: Drop the faculty class roster screen
description: Faculty will continue to use the existing legacy roster system, so the in-portal roster view is withdrawn from scope.

title: Cancel the audit logging requirement
description: Audit logging will be delivered centrally by the platform team, so this requirement is removed from the project scope.

title: Remove the in-portal transcript view
description: Transcripts will continue to be served by the existing student records system, so the in-portal transcript view is no longer required.
